target_customer: Insect farmers, waste managers, food producers and infrastructure investors who want turnkey black soldier fly farms and monitoring technology
problem: Animal feed relies on soymeal and fishmeal. Insect protein is a more sustainable substitute but farming it at industrial scale is inefficient and manual.
business_model: Technology and services for insect farms (hardware plus software, farm design and project management), originally an own-factory insect protein producer; also sells frass fertiliser

founders.name: Keiran Olivares Whitaker
founders.background_notes: Listed as the only founder on the YC page and as founder and CEO in the January 2023 AgFunder article. Background not found in opened sources. The Entocycle site now names James Millar as CEO.

competitors.name: Protix
competitors.what: Dutch black soldier fly producer selling insect protein for aquaculture, pig, poultry and pet feed
competitors.traction_then: Sold feed products in over 12 countries per a 2017 industry summary
competitors.funding_then: EUR 45M equity and debt in June 2017, the largest insect-industry investment cited

competitors.name: AgriProtein
competitors.what: South African maggot farm producing insect-based animal feed protein
competitors.funding_then: $17.5M Series A in December 2016 at a reported $117M valuation

competitors.name: Ynsect
competitors.what: French robotics-enabled mealworm farm positioned as a fishmeal replacement
competitors.funding_then: $15.2M Series B in late 2016, about $40M total

technical_complexity.rationale: Automated, climate-controlled vertical insect production with larvae counting and monitoring needs biology, hardware and software; scaling an industrial factory was hard for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Better monitoring and farm design help, but well-funded rivals pursued the same market and production know-how was not exclusive.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals raised far more, then struggled: AgriProtein's parent group entered administration in February 2021 and Ynsect shows a liquidation in December 2025 per a search summary. Entocycle shifted to selling technology to farmers.

market_need_then: In 2017 insect farms had raised about $124M since 2014 per AgFunder, with big rounds for Protix, AgriProtein and Ynsect, showing investor interest in replacing fishmeal and soy. Entocycle's own pitch cites soymeal and fishmeal as incumbents.

identity.voice_and_tone: Sustainability and industrial; tagline moved from the Insect Farming Company to Waste to Value, powered by insects

branding.brand_signature: Waste to Value, powered by insects

brand_strength.rationale: The name clearly combines entomology and cycle, but no press about the brand itself was found; partnerships with Siemens and Buhler lend credibility rather than brand pull.

pivots.from: Automated factory producing insect protein for farm animals
pivots.to: Technology and farm-design provider for insect farmers
pivots.why: AgFunder January 2023 calls Entocycle a technology company, not a farm, selling Entosight Neo and farm design; the reason is not stated

outcome_analysis: Entocycle began as an automated insect protein factory but later sold technology and project services to insect farmers, which avoided the capital burden that sank some rivals. It raised a $5M Series A from Climentum and Lowercarbon in January 2023 and a $2.6M follow-on in July 2024, and signed partnerships with Buhler and Siemens. Funding is modest and the sector has had failures, so its long-term outcome is still open.
notes: Series A reported as $5M (AgFunder, FeedNavigator), EUR 4.6M (EU-Startups), $5.4M (2024 article); recorded at $5M. UKRI reports a GBP 10M Industrial Strategy Challenge Fund project led by Entocycle (about 2020) but the amount to Entocycle is not stated, so it is not recorded as a round. Total raised of about $8.0M is the outlet's own sum; CB Insights shows $18.55M with an unreliable founding date, unverified. Founding year conflicts: 2014, 2015 and 2016 in various sources; YC says 2017. The July 2024 round has no stage label in the source so it is recorded as other. Outcome search found no administration or closure; most recent item is mid 2025. Ynsect liquidation and AgriProtein administration come from a search summary and are used as context only.
